canonical.form: one file, no copier header, exactly 4194304 bytes
canonical.note: A 512 byte copier header describes the same bytes. Strip it first, then compare. Every digest below is of the bare file.

artifacts.name: Street Fighter Alpha 2, USA
artifacts.provenance: Measured on this machine from a bare file with no copier header. No-Intro names this dump Street Fighter Alpha 2 (USA).

artifacts.name: Street Fighter Zero 2, Japan
artifacts.provenance: Measured on this machine from a bare file with no copier header. No-Intro names this dump Street Fighter Zero 2 (Japan).

artifacts.name: SNES Classic dump with the sound restored
artifacts.provenance: Measured on this machine. This is not a retail cartridge: it carries stream tags and is needed only to regenerate the USA stream table, never to build an image.

not_this.name: An image this project already produced
not_this.why: A build output has the coprocessor removed and its streams expanded, so feeding one back in patches an already patched image. It is a mistake rather than a dump, and the build says so rather than doing it twice.

not_this.name: Star Ocean, Japan
not_this.why: It carries the same S-DD1 and is read here for reference, but it is a different game and no image is built from it.
